stories.title: Execution set for Houston man who killed jeweler in million-dollar diamond heist
stories.summary: Reinaldo Dennes, now 70, would be the ninth and final Texas inmate executed in 2026.

stories.title: Former Texas political candidate says country club voted to expel him
stories.summary: In a statement, he says River Crest Country Club asked him to resign his membership after his controversial posts about the University of Texas in September.

stories.title: Family questions deadly Crosby road rage shooting involving constable's office dispatcher
stories.summary: The family of a 35-year-old man killed in an apparent road rage shooting in Crosby is mourning his death and questioning why the confrontation turned deadly.

stories.title: Who is Falls County Jane Doe? Woman found in 2000 may have died in the 1980s
stories.summary: Investigators found clothing, bedding and a distinctive heart charm alongside the woman's remains.

stories.title: Man killed during confrontation while looking for girlfriend's missing phone, Houston police say
stories.summary: A man was searching for his girlfriend's missing phone when he got into a confrontation that preceded a deadly shooting.

stories.title: 1 dead, another injured in shooting at Willowbrook apartment complex
stories.summary: One person was killed and another injured in a shooting at an apartment complex on Mills Road in northwest Harris County, investigators say.

stories.title: Boil water notice issued for residents in Jersey Village following water pressure issue
stories.summary: The city posted about the boil water notice at around 10:20 p.m. Wednesday after reported water pressure issues earlier in the night.

stories.title: Where you live in Harris County could mean a 20-year difference in life expectancy, report finds
stories.summary: A new Harris County report reveals a more than 20-year gap in life expectancy between communities, along with disparities in child and infant deaths.

stories.title: Juvenile in custody after boy shot inside Humble McDonald’s, police say
stories.summary: Witness says the shooter had a shotgun; victim expected to survive.

stories.title: Could you have a penny worth $235,000? Rare 1943 coin makes its way to Houston shop
stories.summary: A rare World War II-era penny is valued at $235,000. A Houston coin expert explains what makes it so valuable and how to check your own spare change.

stories.title: What sparked the Clean Harbors explosion? Investigators say key questions remain
stories.summary: Investigators say hydrocarbon vapors caused the Clean Harbors explosion, but the ignition source remains unknown. Two earlier fires are also under scrutiny.

stories.title: ‘I’m one of those miracles’ | Veterans celebrate Harris County treatment court graduation
stories.summary: The Harris County Veterans Treatment Court Program connects veterans facing criminal charges with mental health and addiction treatment.
